imutechz: ImuTechz (imutechz.in) is the open-source research & development organisation Shubham founded. It builds IMURUN, the FISH inference engine, the Agents & Skills directory (10,631 open-source entries: 8,034 agents and 2,597 skills across 23 categories) and the imutechz.in website, in public, with contributors welcome.
imurun: IMURUN (v0.3.0) is ImuTechz's local-first AI chat with its own inference engine: FISH, a C++ engine that runs GGUF models on the CPU of your own machine; a Python server for sessions, tools and connectors; and the "Liquid Paper" UI in a native window or the browser. It runs on Windows, macOS and Linux, needs no account, API key or telemetry, and is MIT licensed. Install: pip install imurun (or npx imurun, a thin launcher). Docs: imutechz.in/imu/docs. Repo: github.com/shubham001312/imurun. Site: imutechz.in/imu. Film: youtu.be/bDLHWa3ybqI.
learnify: Learnify is now Check & Mate, a digital capacity-building and learning-management portal, built for the Innova 5.0 project. Trainers build and publish courses, trainees work through them and sit formal assessments, and every attempt rolls up into competency and performance reporting. It has three roles (trainee, trainer, administrator), a 5-step course wizard, AI-drafted questionnaires that trainers review and edit before anything is published (Groq), and Veda-branded performance reports. Stack: vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, FastAPI, Supabase (PostgreSQL, auth, storage). Live at learnify.hosteler.shop; repo github.com/shubham001312/learnify. Learnify began as an AI learning companion for Indian students: college discovery, career guidance and scholarships, with a multilingual assistant, Veda AI (Hindi, English, Bengali, Tamil). It was later rebuilt into Check & Mate.
